title: Cat Guardian — Feline Safety Passport
subtitle: Digital Feline Safety Passport, QR Code & Blind Contact Relay
summary: Open Source platform featuring AI profile generator (Gemini 2.0 Flash), collar QR Codes, and privacy-first Blind Contact Relay (Resend API).
overview: Cat Guardian is a digital feline safety passport combining artificial intelligence, dynamic collar QR codes, and a Blind Contact Relay system. When a cat is marked in 'Lost Mode', scanning the collar displays a public rescue passport while keeping owner contact information private. Communication is routed anonymously through Resend API and Supabase without exposing phone numbers or emails to the client.
roleDescription: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Solutions Architect & AI Integrator.
responsibilities: End-to-end development leadership using React 19, Vite, and TypeScript with Glassmorphism UI.
PostgreSQL schema modeling on Supabase supporting JSONB multilingual profiles and strict Row Level Security (RLS) policies.
Gemini 2.0 Flash API integration with structured prompt engineering for automatic physical descriptions.
Blind Contact Relay implementation using Resend API for anonymous email notifications to pet owners.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Enable anyone who finds a lost pet to contact the owner without exposing sensitive contact details (phone/email) in the frontend or network payload.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Built the Blind Contact Relay integrating Supabase with Resend API. Sightings trigger secure server-side email notifications without sending owner credentials to the browser.

futureEvolution: IoT collar integration for active GPS tracking and virtual geofencing.
OCR data extraction from physical vaccination records.

flowchart TD
    Owner["👤 Cat Owner"] -->|Registers pet & manages passport| App["📱 React 19 Frontend"]

    Finder["🔍 Person who found the pet"] -->|Scans public QR Code| App
